Samsung\'s lock screen only shows Samsung widgets by itself. To add this one: install Good Lock from the Galaxy Store, open it and install LockStar, then in LockStar tap your lock screen, choose Add widget and pick Age Counter.\n\nThe widget\'s seconds tick live. Milliseconds only show here in the app, because Android widgets can\'t redraw that fast. Your date of birth is saved only on this phone.
Slide to 0% for a fully transparent widget that shows only the numbers.
To change a widget\'s style or transparency, long-press it on your home screen and tap Settings.
